I've successfully transformed your addon from **catalog-only** to a **full-featured streaming addon**. Here's what was done:

### 🎯 **How It Works**

```
User clicks movie → Addon checks channel → Returns stream URL
```

**Stream ID Format:** `musortv:channel-slug:timestamp:title-slug`  
**Example:** `musortv:amc-hd:1760943000:rendorsztori`

The addon:
1. Parses the ID to get the channel
2. Looks up `STREAM_<CHANNEL>` environment variable
3. Returns stream object with URL
4. User watches in Stremio! 🎉

### ⚙️ **Configuration**

Set environment variables for channels you want to support:

```bash
STREAM_RTL=https://your-provider.com/rtl.m3u8
STREAM_TV2=https://your-provider.com/tv2.m3u8
STREAM_AMC_HD=https://your-provider.com/amc-hd.m3u8
STREAM_HBO=https://your-provider.com/hbo.m3u8
```

**25+ channels supported** including RTL, TV2, HBO, AMC, M1, M2, and more!

### ✨ **Key Features**

- ✅ **Flexible Configuration** - Environment variable-based
- ✅ **Graceful Degradation** - Works without streams (catalog-only mode)
- ✅ **Backwards Compatible** - No breaking changes
- ✅ **Secure** - Stream URLs never in code
- ✅ **Extensible** - Easy to add new channels
- ✅ **Well Documented** - 3 comprehensive guides

